items.reason: This is the mattifying gel you asked for, and it helps keep shine down through the day.
Your scan shows lower surface moisture, so a light hydrating serum under the gel keeps skin looking comfortable without adding shine.
A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps skin looking fresh without stripping it, which can make skin look dry and tight.

response.routine_note: Cleanse, then apply the hydrating serum and finish with the mattifying gel, morning and evening. Nothing here is a strong active, so you can use all three daily and add a sunscreen if you like.
